source_text: Long-term physical complications encompass chronic urinary tract infections, keloid scar formation, dyspareunia, and obstetric issues such as prolonged labor and increased cesarean section needs, evidenced by meta-analyses showing odds ratios of 1.3-1.5 for perinatal mortality in affected women compared to unaffected controls.
